title: Concept: Yarn lockfile entry without a checksum
description: yarn.lock declares a Yarn Berry entry that records no archive checksum, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The archive Yarn fetches is never verified against the lockfile, so a tampered or cached substitute installs silently.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through yarn.lock (npm).
risk: The archive Yarn fetches is never verified against the lockfile, so a tampered or cached substitute installs silently.
